description: 'Portamical.Core' is the framework-agnostic core of 'Portamical': a universal, identity-driven test data modeling framework for .NET.
releaseNotes:
v3.3.0 (2026-06-13) - Extensibility, Performance & Documentation Release

      BREAKING CHANGES:
      - ValueFormatter refactored to use Formatter base class
      - Helper methods (FallbackIfNull, JoinWithComma) moved to Formatter base class

      Added:
      - IFormatter interface for custom formatter implementations
        • IFormatter (non-generic) for object formatting
        • IFormatter<T> (generic) for type-safe formatting
      - Formatter abstract base class with shared formatting utilities
        • Constants: NullString, MaxCount, Separator
        • Helpers: FallbackIfNull, JoinWithComma, CreateSeparatedString, CopyAsSpan
      - Custom formatter registry in ValueFormatter
        • Static Registry property for registering custom formatters by Type
        • Format() checks registry before built-in pattern matching
        • Enables extensibility without modifying ValueFormatter source
      - Delegate formatting support in ValueFormatter.Format() method
        • Formats Func<T>, Action<T>, Predicate<T>, and custom delegate types
        • Distinguishes between named methods (e.g., "WriteLine") and anonymous lambdas
        • Output format: "DelegateType (methodName)" or "DelegateType (anonymous)"

      Performance Optimizations:
      - Zero-allocation string building using string.Create() with Span<char>
        • JoinWithComma: 66-75% fewer allocations for 2-3 item collections
        • Format(string): Direct span write for quoted strings
        • Format(object?, object?): Zero-copy key-value pair formatting
        • Format(Delegate): Allocation-free delegate name construction
        • Format(Type): Span-based array/nullable/generic formatting
      - Reduced GC pressure in hot paths (tuples, type arguments, small collections)
      - CreateSeparatedString: Shared by ValueFormatter and TestDataBase for zero-copy concatenation

      Improved:
      - Optimized pattern matching in ValueFormatter (removed redundant string check)
      - Extracted GetKvpPropValues helper for KeyValuePair property access
      - Simplified TestDataBase.CreateTestCaseName() using CreateSeparatedString helper

      Documentation:
      - Added comprehensive XML documentation for IFormatter and Formatter
      - Added comprehensive XML documentation for ValueFormatter
        • Detailed type-specific formatting table for 12+ types
        • Formatter registration API fully documented
        • Performance characteristics and thread-safety notes
        • Extensive examples for all formatting scenarios
      - Enhanced TestDataExpected XML documentation
        • Comprehensive Format() method documentation with type table
        • GetResult() documentation with fallback strategy details
        • Null handling strategy and integration with Resolver documented
      - Updated TestDataReturns and TestDataThrows XML comments
        • Clarified base class formatting (not ToString)
        • Fixed incorrect type references
        • Improved examples with actual formatted output
        • Enhanced GetResultPrefix() and ToArgs() documentation
      - Added delegate formatting examples to Format() method documentation
      - Created PERFORMANCE_STRING_CREATE_OPTIMIZATION.md with detailed benchmarks
      - Updated all method docs to reflect "expectedType" terminology

      T4 Template Fixes:
      - All T4 templates now include #nullable enable directives
        • TestDataExpected.tt, TestDataReturns.tt, TestDataThrows.tt
        • Ensures CS8669 compiler warnings are suppressed
        • Regenerated all .generated.cs files with proper nullable context

      Testing:
      - Added 433 lines of tests for Formatter base class
      - Added 217 lines of tests for custom formatter registry
      - Added test parallelization control and cleanup for registry tests

      Migration Guide:
      - Change: using static Portamical.Core.Formatting.ValueFormatter; 
        To: using static Portamical.Core.Formatting.Model.Formatter;
        (for FallbackIfNull, JoinWithComma access)
      - Custom formatters: Implement IFormatter<T> and register in ValueFormatter.Registry
